title: Operation ShadowCloud: initial infection and the GitDoor backdoor
content: A sophisticated cyber intrusion campaign dubbed Operation ShadowCloud has been identified targeting government entities across Asia and Africa. Adversaries deploy two novel backdoors, GitDoor and GraphDoor, through the legitimate MeshAgent utility. These implants conceal command-and-control communications by leveraging cloud platforms including Microsoft SharePoint, GitHub, and Ably messaging... This pulse includes 19 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Government. Associated malware: GitDoor, GraphDoor, MeshAgent.

title: World's Largest Brands Infected With Malware Via Optimizely
content: On 16 November 2026, malicious JavaScript was distributed to 178 organizations through the Optimizely Web experimentation platform, affecting major sites including Zoom, BBC, CNN, Salesforce, GitLab, IKEA, and HSBC. The multi-purpose malware swapped cryptocurrency wallet addresses, skimmed payment cards, stole cookies and screenshots, and deployed Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits targeting... This pulse includes 40 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Finance, Technology, Retail. Associated malware: Coruna, DarkSword.

title: XaocMail ClickFix Campaign Drops Phantom53 and HavoX Across Latin America, Asia, and Europe
content: A Russian-speaking threat actor operates a sophisticated multi-stage campaign utilizing XaocMail phishing platform, Phantom53 DNS-over-HTTPS command-and-control framework, and Havoc post-exploitation toolkit. title: Lotuslite V2: The Evolution of Mustang Panda's .NET Backdoor
content: This analysis identifies Lotuslite V2 as a .NET successor to LOTUSLITE malware, attributed to Mustang Panda (Earth Preta). The campaign targets Thailand through a public Zoho WorkDrive link delivering an assessment-themed ZIP archive.
